title: Major-region money supply (USD)
source: FRED M2SL, ECB M2, FRED/World Bank China and Japan, FRED FX
description: US, euro-area, China, and Japan money supply converted to trillions of USD, plus the four-region total.
summary: This is US, euro-area, Chinese, and Japanese money, all converted into dollars. Each colored line is one region; the orange line is the four-region total. In 2024, these four were about 59% of World Bank global broad money ($90T of $152T). UK, India, and the rest of EM make up most of the remainder. Of this basket, China is about 49.8%, the US 22.1%, Europe 18.1%, Japan 10.0%. China after 2019 and Japan after late 2023 use World Bank annual figures (plus a PBOC May 2026 China print), so the last few years are less precise. FX moves the dollar lines even when local money is unchanged.
